item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-109515 - mailoptin mailoptin Improper Privilege Management
item.description:
The MailOptin – Popup, Optin Forms & Email Newsletters for Mailchimp, HubSpot, AWeber Etc. plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.78.6 This is due to the `subscribe_to_email_list` endpoint accepting an attacker-supplied `optin_data[form_custom_field_mappings]` parameter without any allow-list validation on destination keys, allowing the attacker-controlled mapping to override the administrator's saved mapping and pass arbitrary `wp_users` column names — including `ID` and `user_pass` — directly into `wp_insert_user()` via the `subscribe()` function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to force `wp_insert_user()` into UPDATE mode on any existing account by supplying a target user's numeric `ID`, overwrite that account's password with a pre-hashed value of their choosing, and thereby take over any WordPress user account — including administrators — leading to full site compromise. Exploitation requires that a WordPress User Registration opt-in form is published somewhere on the site, though the form's UUID is visible in page source and no authentication, nonce, or capability check is required to reach the vulnerable endpoint.

Vendor: mailoptin
Product: mailoptin

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/mailoptin/vulnerability/wordpress-mailoptin-popup-optin-forms-email-newsletters-for-mailchimp-hubspot-aweber-etc-plugin-1-2-78-6-unauthenticated-privilege-escalation-to-form-custom-field-mappings-parameter-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-97668 - Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
item.description:
The Abandoned Cart Pro for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the guest cart persistent meta_value in all versions up to, and including, 10.8.0 due to insufficient escaping on user supplied data and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query in the update_guest_persistent_cart() function. The abandoned_cart_info value, populated from attacker-controlled checkout fields such as the SMS consent field, is passed through stripslashes() and concatenated directly into an UPDATE statement while the adjacent SELECT and INSERT use prepared statements. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL to the query. Because the sink is an UPDATE ... SET on the wp_usermeta table, the injection can both extract sensitive information from the database via time-based blind techniques and modify usermeta rows; it has been demonstrated to escalate an arbitrary account to administrator by writing a wp_capabilities row that shadows the legitimate one.

Vendor: Tyche Softwares
Product: Abandoned Cart Pro for WooCommerce

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/woocommerce-abandon-cart-pro/vulnerability/wordpress-abandoned-cart-pro-for-woocommerce-plugin-10-8-0-unauthenticated-sql-injection-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-103895 - Improper Authentication
item.description:
The miniOrange OTP Login, Verification and SMS Notifications plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in versions up to, and including, 5.5.8 via the `mo_by_pass_login()` function. This is due to `mo_delay_otp_process()` short-circuiting the authentication flow before password validation or the administrator intent gate (added in 5.5.6) can run, combined with the Delay OTP grace flag (`mov_last_verified_dttm`) being stored as a `user_meta` row keyed solely by target user ID with no binding to the originating session, cookie, IP address, or device. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any WordPress user — including administrators — by submitting only a known username with the `mo_wp_login_intent=otp` parameter and any non-empty password, thereby inheriting a legitimate user's open Delay OTP grace window without ever supplying correct credentials. Exploitation requires the site to have OTP-only login (`wp_login_skip_password=1`, `wp_login_skip_password_fallback=0`) and Delay OTP Verification (`wp_login_delay_otp=1`) enabled, and the target account must currently be within its configured Delay OTP interval.

Vendor: cyberlord92
Product: miniOrange OTP Login, Verification and SMS Notifications

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/miniorange-otp-verification/vulnerability/wordpress-miniorange-otp-login-verification-and-sms-notifications-plugin-5-5-8-unauthenticated-authentication-bypass-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-59774 - Gitea Gitea Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
item.description:
Gitea's Org-mode markup renderer processes INCLUDE directives supplied to the repository markup endpoint without preventing access to server-side files. An unauthenticated attacker can use a suitable public repository to read files accessible to the Gitea service account. If the disclosed files include app.ini and its INTERNAL_TOKEN, the attacker can chain the disclosure with internal logger access to modify a Git hook and execute commands as the Gitea service account.

Vendor: Gitea
Product: Gitea

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://previdian.com/CVE-2026-59774
